title: 権限チェック後にpathが差し替わる／checkより先に読むことで、deny規則が実効しない
summary: Claude Code v2.1.251 fixed a cluster of bypasses in which the permission decision and the filesystem access referred to different objects: Read/Write/Edit followed a symlink swapped inside the working directory after the permission check; Grep and Glob did not apply Read(...) deny rules through symlinked search paths; the Workflow tool read (and quoted in error text) a scriptPath outside the readable set before the permission check ran; and plugin commands could point outside the plugin directory via path traversal. Configured deny rules such as **/.env were therefore advisory rather than enforced for some tool paths.

evidence.title: claude-code CHANGELOG v2.1.251
evidence.summary: 'Fixed file tools (Read, Write, Edit) following a symlink swapped inside the working directory after the permission check'; Grep/Glob not applying Read(...) deny rules through symlinked search paths; 'Fixed the Workflow tool reading (and quoting in errors) a scriptPath outside what the session may read before the permission check ran'; plugin commands pointing outside the plugin directory via path traversal.

notes: Same mechanism, artifact and practical response as I16 (intrusion via a vulnerability in the sandbox / extension / agent itself): the fix is to upgrade to v2.1.251+. Filed as an update rather than a new problem, but worth recording on I16 that deny rules were demonstrably non-enforcing for symlinked and pre-check read paths before 2026-08-28, so any team that relied on **/.env-style deny rules for secret protection should treat pre-2.1.251 sessions as having had unverified access.
